_help: Edit this file to change the questions. Each question needs: id (unique), topic, prompt, correct (the right answer), wrong (1-3 wrong answers), explain (one short sentence shown after answering). Topics are made automatically from the 'topic' values.

questions.prompt: Which plane splits the body into LEFT and RIGHT halves?
questions.explain: The sagittal plane runs front-to-back and splits the body into left and right.

questions.prompt: Which plane splits the body into FRONT (anterior) and BACK (posterior)?
questions.explain: The frontal (coronal) plane runs side-to-side and splits the body into front and back.

questions.prompt: Which plane splits the body into UPPER (superior) and LOWER (inferior) parts?
questions.explain: The transverse (horizontal) plane splits the body into top and bottom.

questions.prompt: Elbow flexion in a biceps curl happens in which plane?
questions.explain: Flexion and extension happen in the sagittal plane.

questions.prompt: Arm movement in a jumping jack (shoulder abduction/adduction) happens in which plane?
questions.explain: Abduction and adduction happen in the frontal plane.

questions.prompt: A golfer's trunk rotation during the backswing happens in which plane?
questions.explain: Rotation happens in the transverse plane.

questions.prompt: Hip flexion when kicking a soccer ball happens in which plane?
questions.explain: The leg swings forward and back: flexion/extension in the sagittal plane.

questions.prompt: A dumbbell lateral (side) raise moves the arm in which plane?
questions.explain: Lifting the arm out to the side is abduction in the frontal plane.

questions.prompt: A gymnast's somersault happens in which plane?
questions.explain: A somersault turns head-over-heels, forward or back: the sagittal plane.

questions.prompt: A cartwheel happens in which plane?
questions.explain: A cartwheel turns sideways: the frontal plane.

questions.prompt: A figure skater's spin happens in which plane?
questions.explain: Spinning around your long body line is rotation in the transverse plane.

questions.prompt: Bending the trunk sideways (lateral flexion) happens in which plane?
questions.explain: Sideways bending is lateral flexion in the frontal plane.

questions.prompt: Turning a doorknob (forearm pronation/supination) happens in which plane?
questions.explain: Pronation and supination are rotations of the forearm: transverse plane.

questions.prompt: Flexion and extension rotate around which axis?
questions.explain: The mediolateral axis runs side to side, like a hinge pin through the joint.

questions.prompt: Abduction and adduction rotate around which axis?
questions.explain: The anteroposterior axis runs from front to back.

questions.prompt: Rotation of the trunk or a limb happens around which axis?
questions.explain: The longitudinal axis runs from head to toe.

questions.prompt: A somersault rotates around which axis?
questions.explain: Sagittal plane movement turns around the side-to-side (mediolateral) axis.

questions.prompt: A cartwheel rotates around which axis?
questions.explain: Frontal plane movement turns around the front-to-back (anteroposterior) axis.

questions.prompt: A ballet pirouette rotates around which axis?
questions.explain: Spinning on the spot turns around the head-to-toe (longitudinal) axis.

questions.prompt: Which plane and axis go together correctly?
questions.explain: Pairs: sagittal + mediolateral, frontal + anteroposterior, transverse + longitudinal.

questions.prompt: Which plane and axis go together correctly?
questions.explain: Pairs: sagittal + mediolateral, frontal + anteroposterior, transverse + longitudinal.

questions.prompt: How does an axis sit compared to its plane of movement?
questions.explain: The axis always runs at right angles through the plane it moves in.

questions.prompt: A golfer's swing (trunk rotation) turns around which axis?
questions.explain: Transverse plane rotation turns around the longitudinal axis.

questions.prompt: Which movement DECREASES the angle at a joint?
questions.explain: Flexion bends the joint and closes the angle.

questions.prompt: Which movement INCREASES the angle at a joint?
questions.explain: Extension straightens the joint and opens the angle.

questions.prompt: Moving a limb AWAY from the midline of the body is called…
questions.explain: Abduction = moving away from the midline (think 'abduct' = take away).

questions.prompt: Moving a limb TOWARD the midline of the body is called…
questions.explain: Adduction = moving toward the midline (you 'add' it back to the body).

questions.prompt: Pointing the toes down (e.g. rising onto tiptoes) is called…
questions.explain: Plantar flexion moves the sole of the foot down, away from the shin.

questions.prompt: Pulling the toes up toward the shin is called…
questions.explain: Dorsiflexion brings the top (dorsum) of the foot toward the shin.

questions.prompt: Turning the palm to face UP (or forward) is called…
questions.explain: Supination = palm up, like holding a bowl of soup.

questions.prompt: Turning the palm to face DOWN (or back) is called…
questions.explain: Pronation = palm down.

questions.prompt: Turning the sole of the foot INWARD is called…
questions.explain: Inversion turns the sole in. Rolling into too much inversion is a common ankle sprain.

questions.prompt: Turning the sole of the foot OUTWARD is called…
questions.explain: Eversion turns the sole out.

questions.prompt: Arm circles, where the limb draws a cone shape, are called…
questions.explain: Circumduction combines flexion, extension, abduction and adduction.

questions.prompt: Shrugging the shoulders upward is called…
questions.explain: Elevation moves a body part up. Depression moves it down.

questions.prompt: Extending a joint past its anatomical position (e.g. arching the back) is called…
questions.explain: Hyperextension = extension beyond the normal anatomical position.

questions.prompt: Turning a limb TOWARD the midline around its long axis is called…
questions.explain: Medial rotation turns the front of the limb in toward the body.

questions.prompt: In a chest fly, the arms move toward each other at shoulder height. This is…
questions.explain: Horizontal adduction moves the arm toward the midline in the transverse plane.

questions.prompt: Basketball jump shot: what happens at the KNEE as the player jumps up?
questions.explain: The knee straightens (extension) in the sagittal plane, around the mediolateral axis.

questions.prompt: Squat, going DOWN: what happens at the hip and knee?
questions.explain: Lowering into a squat bends (flexes) the hip and knee.

questions.prompt: Push-up, lowering phase: what happens at the ELBOW?
questions.explain: The elbow bends as the chest goes down: flexion.

questions.prompt: A sprinter pushing off the blocks: what happens at the ANKLE?
questions.explain: Pushing the toes down into the ground is plantar flexion.

questions.prompt: Discus throw, turning in the circle: which movement, plane and axis?
questions.explain: Spinning the body is rotation in the transverse plane, around the longitudinal axis.

questions.prompt: Goalkeeper diving sideways with arms reaching out: what happens at the shoulder?
questions.explain: Arms move out from the midline: abduction in the frontal plane, around the anteroposterior axis.

questions.prompt: Front crawl swimming: the arm drawing a full circle at the shoulder is…
questions.explain: A full circle at a ball-and-socket joint is circumduction.

questions.prompt: Volleyball dig: the forearms face up to the ball. The forearms are in…
questions.explain: Palms and forearms turned up = supination.
